messages:
elena: FYI SkyFoundry confirmed rack access next Tue for a joint perf/W sweep. They want us to bring kernel variants, runtime images, and telemetry. Can we list what we need and who owns each part? cc @samir @jin

samir: I can own kernel builds + hooks. Will bring two tune flavors: nvlink-agg and latency-optimized. We should collect power, GPU util, clocks, PCIe util, and kernel-level latency histograms.

jin: Ill build Docker images for runtime v2.4 and v2.5. What seq lengths and batch sizes do we want? I propose seq=1024,2048 and batch=1,4.

marcos: Important: run both steady-state (5m warmup + 15m sample) and burst runs (30s p95). Also record thermal and power-capping settings. Without consistent caps numbers will vary a lot.

elena: Plan = two passes: steady-state (capped at partner-recommended Pstate) and uncapped burst. Also capture KV-cache hit rate and prefix reuse. Ill coordinate with SkyFoundry FW team about Pstate knobs.

samir: Kernel build snippet I'll use (for reproducibility):
```bash
# local build
make -j20 MODE=release KERNEL_TUNE=nvlink_agg PERF_COUNTERS=1
```
Telemetry collection commands:
```bash
# GPU slow-sampling
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,index,name,power.draw,utilization.gpu,clocks.gr,temperature.gpu --format=csv -lms 100 > /tmp/gpu_telemetry.csv &
# NVLink/PCIe counters (partner agent)
# perf-style traces collected via partner tool: sf-trace --out sf_trace.pb --interval 100ms
```

jin: Docker run + env well use:
```bash
docker run --gpus all \ 
  -e RUN_ID=$RUN_ID \ 
  -e SEQ_LEN=1024 \ 
  -e BATCH=1 \ 
  -v /mnt/sf-shared:/results \ 
  ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:2.5-tuned /bin/bash -c "./run_bench.sh --model gptj --tokens 100000"
```
Also pushing image tags to ghcr and a tarball for SkyFoundry to load locally.

marcos: We need a short experiment matrix file (so we can link results to configs). Suggest naming: SF2026-<RUN_ID>-matrix.csv and include fields: run_id, model, kernel_tag, seq_len, batch, pstate, capped, notes. I can create that and gsheet.

elena: Good. Also we need a short runbook doc (1 page) that ops can follow. Jin/Samir can you drop a 5-step runbook here by EOD Fri? I'll consolidate and send to SkyFoundry.

samir: Ill do a dry-run Mon 09:00 in our lab with an identical conf. Should catch obvious regressions.

jin: Monday 10:00 is fine for my side to validate images.

ops-bot: lab-rack-reservation confirmed: SkyFoundry rack booked Tue 09:00-17:00. Ticket SF-4782.

elena: Perfect. Last ask: no external announcement until we have partner signoff on numbers and joint statement. Ill draft a comms outline after the dry run. :white_check_mark: 

marcos: Adding a note — please set RUN_ID env and upload raw traces + telemetry to gs://redwood-sf-bench/$RUN_ID for analysis. Ill run the postproc scripts to compute perf/W and p95 p99 latencies.

samir: Agreed. Also keeping a small prometheus scrape on host for process-level metrics. Ill add the scrape config to the repo.

elena: Thanks all — putting actions in a checklist and sharing shortly. If anything else needed ping me here. :sparkles:
